metadata.scope: Canada/U.S. BTS/FRA main rail network and major industrial leads; archival EIA terminal observations from university-hosted copies, reviewed Buckeye operator-map points, Colonial street-address locations, Cushing Grandstaff regulator office location, and a curated Canadian terminal/storage set. Neither the terminal set nor minor tracks, yards, sidings, and private spurs represents complete national coverage.
metadata.rail_detail: BTS/FRA NET=M main network and NET=I major industrial leads, grouped by category, country, and owner for browser performance.
metadata.geometry_precision_note: Rail coordinates are rounded to 0.001 degree for display (up to about 111 m per grid step); facility points retain 0.00001 degree. Source precision is not survey accuracy.
metadata.terminal_inventory_note: Source observations, not unique-site totals. Archived EIA and current operator identities are not merged on city or operator alone. Source/review dates and coordinate provenance are separate; no claim of complete national storage coverage.
metadata.terminal_capacity_note: Published capacity observations retain their individual units, scopes, bases and source dates. They are not summed, converted, or interpreted as available capacity, inventory or throughput.

sources.name: BTS/FRA North American Rail Network Lines
sources.coverage: Canada/U.S. main network and major industrial leads clipped to the requested rail extent; not every local track, siding, yard, or private spur

sources.name: Archived EIA Crude Oil Rail Terminals (University of Minnesota copy)
sources.coverage: 94 valid points from a 99-record public copy snapshot; underlying inventory date unavailable. Canonical EIA origin requires a token; university copy edits do not certify current operations.

sources.name: January 2020 EIA Petroleum Product Terminals (UC Merced copy)
sources.coverage: 1,476 archived EIA-815 observations as of January 2020, from a public UC Merced-hosted copy. Canonical EIA origin requires a token. Historical operator names are preserved separately from reviewed identities.

sources.name: Reviewed Canadian petroleum terminals
sources.coverage: 88 curated Canadian terminal/storage observations with individual coordinate provenance and review status, including 2024 NPRI points; unresolved legacy points remain explicitly unverified. Not a complete national registry.

sources.name: Buckeye operator public asset map
sources.coverage: 128 U.S. terminal observations including two propane terminals and Puerto Rico; Bahamas and Saint Lucia omitted. Operator GIS source edited March 2023; identity review does not certify operation or survey accuracy.

sources.name: Colonial Pipeline own terminals
sources.coverage: Three operator-listed storage sites placed at Census street-address interpolations, explicitly low confidence. Fredericksburg held out because source postal codes conflict. The approximately 270 connected third-party sites are not assumed Colonial-owned.

sources.name: Oklahoma DEQ Cushing Grandstaff storage facility
sources.coverage: One dated regulator office-location point, not a surveyed tank centroid or a current permit-status claim. No capacity is assigned to the entire complex from a commercial subset fact sheet.
